Orange-pink Hybrid Tea, Cl..
Exhibition name: Michel Desjoyeaux ®
rows.Bloom: Deep pink, golden-yellow center, orange undertones. Yellow with orange edges (Rosier vigoureux au large feuillage vernissé portant des fleurs lumineuses rose sur le bord et jaune orangé au centre.). Strong fragrance. up to 35 petals. Average diameter 5.5". Very large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Large, glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 28" to 35" (70 to 90cm). Width: 2' (60cm).
